## Change

Describe the scope and reason.

## Evidence

Separate mocked tests, observed readback and physical behavior. Link a sanitized reproduction if relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] Protocol/state logic stays in the shared library
- [ ] Regression tests added or updated
- [ ] fmt, tests and strict clippy pass
- [ ] Publication/privacy gate passes; no device identities or experiments
- [ ] No automatic hardware/audio/firmware test added
- [ ] UI-only state and remaining unknowns are documented
- [ ] New dependency/asset licenses reviewed
